__comment: Seasonal colour palettes for active surface block variants (grass × 8, dirt × 4).
Loaded once at boot alongside terrain_blocks.json.
variant_key — suffix of the block URI: 'grass_01' … 'grass_08', 'dirt_01' … 'dirt_04'
Stonehearth-style lowland rings: grass_01 = grass_edge_1, grass_02 = grass_edge_2, grass_03 = soft fade, grass_04 = base grass
grass_05...grass_08 keep the local highland/foothill edge pairs
spring  — fresh yellow-greens to medium greens; lighter, higher lightness
summer  — muted Stonehearth-like greens; the hex_color baseline in terrain_blocks.json is only a fallback
autumn  — warm olive, gold, and rusty grass tones
winter  — snow whites with a cool blue-grey tint; low saturation
spring  — darker and wetter; rain-soaked earth
summer  — dry and pale; the hex_color baseline in terrain_blocks.json
autumn  — mid-tone earthy brown; leaf-litter undertone
__comment_dirt: 4 dirt variants — rain-soaked in spring, dry in summer, earthy in autumn, frost-grey in winter
